description: Experiment with CSS filters on a sample image: grayscale, sepia, blur, brightness, contrast, hue, saturate and invert, then copy the filter CSS.

faqs.a: All of them — brightness, contrast, saturate, hue-rotate and the rest are the exact CSS filter functions, so the copied line behaves identically on your own images.
faqs.q: Do the sliders map to real CSS filter functions?

faqs.a: Yes — wrap multiple elements or apply the class to a container; filters apply to everything rendered inside.
faqs.q: Can I use the output on a whole section?

faqs.a: The preview uses a canvas-drawn sample image so it works offline and loads instantly. Apply the copied filter class to your own or element.
faqs.q: Why a drawn sample image instead of a photo?

howto: Drag any of the eight filter sliders.
Watch the sample image update live.
Click "Copy filter CSS" to grab the one-line filter declaration.
title: CSS Filter Playground
